WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.recordregistry AS flow_id,
         a.critfindnum * 1.0 / (a.findtally + 1) AS afs,
         (a.accreqnum + a.delreqnum + a.rectreqnum + a.portreqnum) AS dsrl,
         CAST(julianday('2025-04-01') - julianday(a.remeddue) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
  FROM auditandcompliance a
  JOIN dataprofile p ON p.profiletrace = a.profjoin
  JOIN dataflow f ON f.recordregistry = p.flowsign
  WHERE f.orignation <> f.destnation
)
SELECT flow_id,
       ROUND(afs * dsrl * afs, 2) AS acp,
       days_overdue
FROM base
WHERE afs * dsrl * afs > 5
  AND days_overdue >= -5
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, acp DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT f.recordregistry AS flow_id,
       ROUND(r.riskassess / r.ctrleff, 2) AS risk_exposure_score,
       ROUND(p.volgb * CASE p.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END, 2) AS data_sensitivity_index
FROM dataflow f
LEFT JOIN riskmanagement r ON r.flowlink = f.recordregistry
LEFT JOIN dataprofile p ON p.flowsign = f.recordregistry
WHERE r.riskassess / r.ctrleff > 0.7
  AND p.volgb * CASE p.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END > 100
ORDER BY data_sensitivity_index DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH cb AS (
  SELECT f.recordregistry AS flow_id,
         (r.riskassess / r.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN f.orignation <> f.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cbrf,
         (r.riskassess / r.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN f.orignation <> f.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * p.volgb AS cdvr
  FROM dataflow f
  JOIN riskmanagement r ON r.flowlink = f.recordregistry
  JOIN dataprofile p ON p.flowsign = f.recordregistry
  WHERE f.orignation <> f.destnation
)
SELECT flow_id,
       ROUND(cbrf, 2) AS cbrf,
       ROUND(cdvr, 2) AS cdvr,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cdvr DESC) AS cdvr_rank
FROM cb
WHERE cdvr > 1000
ORDER BY cdvr DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH d AS (
  SELECT audittrace,
         (accreqnum + delreqnum + rectreqnum + portreqnum) * resptimeday AS dsrp,
         accreqnum, delreqnum, rectreqnum, portreqnum
  FROM auditandcompliance
  WHERE (accreqnum + delreqnum + rectreqnum + portreqnum) * resptimeday > 50
),
t(i) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4))
SELECT d.audittrace AS audit_id,
       ROUND(d.dsrp, 2) AS dsrp,
       CASE t.i
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Access: ' || d.accreqnum
         WHEN 2 THEN 'Deletion: ' || d.delreqnum
         WHEN 3 THEN 'Rectification: ' || d.rectreqnum
         ELSE 'Portability: ' || d.portreqnum
       END AS request_breakdown
FROM d JOIN t
ORDER BY d.dsrp DESC, d.audittrace, t.i
LIMIT 100

WITH v AS (
  SELECT (CASE vendsecrate WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
         * (CASE WHEN contrstate = 'Active' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END) AS vri
  FROM vendormanagement
)
SELECT CASE WHEN vri < 2 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN vri < 3 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_tier,
       COUNT(*) AS vendor_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendormanagement), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM v
GROUP BY risk_tier
ORDER BY vendor_count DESC

SELECT c.compliancetrace AS compliance_id,
       c.gdprcomp AS gdpr_compliance,
       c.loclawcomp AS local_law_compliance,
       f.orignation || ' -> ' || f.destnation AS transfer_path
FROM compliance c
JOIN riskmanagement r ON r.risktrace = c.risktie
JOIN dataflow f ON f.recordregistry = r.flowlink
WHERE c.gdprcomp = 'Non-compliant'
   OR (c.loclawcomp = 'Non-compliant' AND f.orignation <> f.destnation)
ORDER BY c.compliancetrace ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT recordregistry AS flow_id,
       ROUND(bwidthpct * datasizemb / durmin, 2) AS bsi,
       ROUND(successpct / (errtally + 1.0), 2) AS dte
FROM dataflow
WHERE bwidthpct * datasizemb / durmin > 50
  AND successpct / (errtally + 1.0) < 1.0
ORDER BY bsi DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT json_object(
         'ProfileTrace', p.profiletrace,
         'DataSensitivityIndex', ROUND(p.volgb * CASE p.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END, 2),
         'SecurityRobustnessScore', CASE WHEN s.encstate = 'Full' AND s.aclstate = 'Strong' THEN 3
                                         WHEN s.encstate = 'Full' OR s.aclstate = 'Adequate' THEN 2
                                         ELSE 1 END
       ) AS profile_json
FROM dataprofile p
JOIN securityprofile s ON s.profilekey = p.profiletrace
WHERE p.volgb * CASE p.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END > 100
  AND CASE WHEN s.encstate = 'Full' AND s.aclstate = 'Strong' THEN 3
           WHEN s.encstate = 'Full' OR s.aclstate = 'Adequate' THEN 2
           ELSE 1 END < 2
ORDER BY p.volgb * CASE p.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH crit AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', remeddue) AS month,
         critfindnum * 1.0 / (findtally + 1) AS afs
  FROM auditandcompliance
  WHERE critfindnum * 1.0 / (findtally + 1) > 0.5
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT month, AVG(afs) AS avg_afs FROM crit GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, avg_afs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_afs DESC) AS severity_rank FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, ROUND(avg_afs, 2) AS avg_afs, severity_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE severity_rank <= 3
ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT profiletrace AS profile_id,
       (CASE WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN csumverify = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ifc,
       CASE WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' AND csumverify = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check, Checksum Verification'
            WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check'
            ELSE 'Checksum Verification' END AS failure_types
FROM dataprofile
WHERE intcheck = 'Failed' OR csumverify = 'Failed'
ORDER BY ifc DESC
LIMIT 10
